noun_definition: Thread refers to a conversation initiated in a Room that remains visible in the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) if no comments are added to it.

Thread report refers to a notification or indication of a newly created discussion thread in a chat room that remains visible in the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) even if no comments have been made on it.
room refers to a specific chat space within the application where users can send messages and create threads.
lhn refers to the left-hand navigation panel in the Expensify application where users can access different Rooms and threads.
